scope: Development browser validation, four EN/AR Office cases
failure: Both mixed-board journeys used exact getByLabel on the Save to wrapped select. Its accessible combobox name was correct; label text included option contents. Updated harness to getByRole(combobox, name, exact). No product fix for this initial failure.

limits: Not a production visual, device performance, native-reader or full assistive-technology certification. Later runs are separate evidence.
